content: Umoja mu hyegha jaka Kristo
Bhela, nepani nemili nkongeka kwa ndandi ja kuntumaki Bambo, nundobha mtamaje kwa luhomu lwinu molupalakila mu ulohakeku winu ghondowakike.
Kwa kuliheleha na upole na kwa uhinakilu na kutolanela mabheti kwa mabheti kwa upalu.
Mkangamalaje kulenda umoja ghouletakiki na Roho kwa kulujengalela lukwali lolubhi pachilanda jinu.
Kubhi na hyegha jimu na Roho jumu, na lihobhalelu limu lemulohakike na Chapanga.
Kabheti kubhi na Bambo jumu, uhobhalelu ghumu, na ubatizo ghumu,
kubhi na Chapanga jumu ambaju nde Atati wa bhokapi, joabhi panani ja ghokapi, mu ghokapi, na mkati ja ghokapi.
Nambu kila jumu witu akapekiwi chihomu chaki kulengana na chipemu cha nhupu waki cheapekiwi na Kristo.
Ngati moghapwaghi Malembu Mahuhu:
Bhela, lilobhi heli palipwagha: “Akagholwiki kunani,” bho, ndandi jaki kike? Ndandi jaki nde kupwagha kubha kutumbula Kristo akahelili upambala wa pahi nakanopi wa pundema.
Bhela jombi joakahulwiki hoju pani pundema nde joakagholwiki kunani nakanopi kupeta kunani kumahunde koha, nahuli apata kuutwelakela ndema wokapi.
Jombi nde joabhekiki bhandu bhangi kubha mitumi, bhangi kubha bhalota, bhangi bhabhatangaza Malobhi Manyahi, bhangi kubha bhadima na bhangi kubha bhabhola.
Akatendiki bhenibhela nahuli apata kubhakamilisha bhahuhu bhokapi kwa ndandi ja kutenda lihengu, nahuli kujichenga hyegha jaka Kristo.
Mbaka tabhokapi tuuhikilaje umoja wa uhobhalelu na kummanya nakanopi Mwana waka Chapanga, na kubha mundu mkamilifu, na kuhikila mu chipemu cha utimilifu waka Kristo.
Nahuli ngatwikubha kabhete bhana bhang'eng'a, tukalekalika koni na koni na kutolakeka na kila mpongu wa mabholu gha upuhi gha bhandu, kwa kuchenjela, kwa kuijengalela indela yabhu ya upuhi.
Nambu tupwaghanya chakaka kwa mtima wa upalu, mu kila lijambu na kukola hata kunhikila jombi joabhi mmutu, yani, Kristo.

Pahi ja ujemalelu waki, ihungu yokapi ya hyegha ilombini na kukamulana papamu na miheleti, na hyegha jokapi jijangatana kwa ujangatilu wa ihungu yaki. Bhela ngati kila chiungu chihenga lihengu laki ngati moipalakila, hyegha jokapi jikola na kulichenga mu upalu.
Matamu Ghahenu muka Kristo
Bhela, kwa lihina laka Bambo, nundakalila: Ngamwijendalela kutama kwa luhomu ngati bhandu bhangakummanya Chapanga, ambabhu maholalelu ghabhu ngacheghabhi na ndandi jokapi.
Malangu gha bhandu bhanihabha ghajeghaliki lwihi, na bhabhi kutali na womi waka Chapanga kwa ndandi ja ung'ang'a ghoubhi mkati jabhu na ing'omu ya mitima jabhu.
Bhahobhiki na ngachebhabhi na ihoni, bhalijeghela mu mambu machafu, na kupala kutenda kila ntundu wa uhakau koni bhakajendalya kutokulela kubha na hindu yamaheli nakanopi.
Nambu mwehapa ngachemulibholiki bhenibhela panani jaka Kristo.
Nde chakaka kubha, mwehapa njowini wichu, kabhete mbolakiki naku, uchakaka ghola ghoubhi muka Yesu.
Bhela mululekaje luhomu lwinu lwa mwande, lolukabhi lumpeleka mu kuyonangeka kwa kujengalela utokulelu ghoukabhi unkolowa mwenga.
Nahuli mtendakikaje bhahenu mu roho na maholalelu ghinu.
Mkawataje utu wahenu, ghoubhombakiki kulengana na ulenganesu waka Chapanga na ambau ulilangiha mu matamu gha chakaka gha wambone na uhuhu.
Bhela muuleka upuhi! Kila mundu impalika kumpwaghi njaki uchakaka, maghambu kila jumu witu nde kiungu cha hyegha jaka njaki.
Mkubhaje na inyela, nambu ngamwitenda mahoku, na wala ngamwitama na mabhinilu mbaka lyobha kujibhila,
nahuli ngamwampekeha Shetani mbekenyu.
Joakabhi ajibha, ngaijibha kabhete, nambu atumbula kuhenga lihengu linyahi kwa mabhoku ghaki, apata kubha na chindu cha kunjangatila mundu joabhi kahochu.
Malobhi mahakau ngaghipita ng'o mumilomu jinu, nambu ghala ghaghajangatila kwa ndandi ja kubhachenga bhangi nahuli lapekya chihomu bhabhalijowana.
Ngamwanhuzunisha Roho Mhuhu waka Chapanga, ndandi Roho hoju nde muhuli waka Chapanga kwinu kubha mwehapa nde bhandu bhaki, na nde kulangiha kubha lichobha lihika ambapu Chapanga anaamkombulaje.
Mboha mangani mabhinilu, na kuhyoma na inyela na njobhela na matondu, na nkotukaje kila ntundu wa uhakau.
Mkubhaje na mtima wambone na ghoubhi na chiha, kila jumu na andekakya njaki mahoku ghaki ngati bhela Chapanga moandekakili mwenga mahoku ghinu kwa kupetela Kristo.
